pool.text: The oldest building in Amsterdam is the Oude Kerk, consecrated in this year.
The Mirakel van Amsterdam rendered the city an important place of pilgrimage.
Maximilian I awarded Amsterdam the right to adorn its coat of arms with the crown.
The king's crown on the coat of arms was replaced with Maximilian's imperial crown.
The largely Catholic city joined the revolt against Spanish rule.
The Amsterdam office of the Dutch East India Company became a stock exchange.
Amsterdam was intended to be the hub of the highway system of the Netherlands.
Nazi Germany invaded the Netherlands and took control of the country.
427 Amsterdam Jews were arrested and sent to Mauthausen concentration camp.
The city was finally liberated by Canadian forces shortly before the end.
Queen Wilhelmina bestowed the official motto Heldhaftig, Vastberaden, Barmhartig on the city.
The Amsterdam–Rhine Canal opened to shipping as the principal inland route.
The A3 to Rotterdam was cancelled to conserve the Groene Hart.
A metro began operating between Bijlmermeer and the centre of Amsterdam.
The municipality of Amsterdam has gradually been divided into semi-autonomous boroughs called stadsdelen.
The constitutional revision mentioned Amsterdam and capital in chapter 2 article 32.
The English-language comedy scene was established with the founding of Boom Chicago.
Construction of a new metro line connecting north and south started.
The British drama series Bad Girls filmed scenes on location in Amsterdam.
About 83000 bicycles were stolen in Amsterdam.
